recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit and do not restore the STU3/R4-era con-3 or category binding for FHIR-18833. Revisit only if Patient Care resolves a newer issue such as FHIR-54868 to change R6 clinicalStatus cardinality or category guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-18833 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested removing the unconditional Condition.clinicalStatus requirement, with the approved modification tying clinicalStatus guidance to Condition.category and encounter-diagnosis/problem-list-item use cases.
initial_application: Commit 3d048a25d4fb changed the historical Condition.category binding from example to extensible, and commit 27de028df2d3 changed con-3 into a best-practice problem-list-item clinicalStatus rule in source/condition/condition-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-29409 later made Condition.clinicalStatus 1..1, removed the old con-3 dependency on problem-list-item, loosened category, and relied on an unknown status code implemented by UP-280; FHIR-37986 added unknown to the short display. FHIR-48358 and FHIR-54454 later changed Condition.category to an example binding, removed the problem-list-item unknown warning, and generalized the category short display. FHIR-54868 is a newer Triaged request to make clinicalStatus optional again, but it is unresolved.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active source has Condition.clinicalStatus min 1 with unknown guidance, Condition.category example binding, and con-3 as an abatement consistency rule rather than the old FHIR-18833 clinicalStatus requirement.
